brief: An AI startup. The mark has to feel precise and intelligent, calm and trustworthy, and human and approachable — and it has to survive as a 16 px favicon and a circular social avatar.
criteria: Success: reads as intelligent and human at once — not cold, and not one of the category clichés (robot heads, brain circuits, glowing nodes); stays legible at 16 px; works in one colour; crop-safe as a circular avatar.
recommendation: The Woven Frame — one continuous thread that weaves a frame around an 'A'. Green distinguishes an AI brand in a sea of blue, the thread supplies the human warmth, and the mark still reads as a monogram at 16 px.

Proof the green: match Pantone 341 C on a physical chip and approve a CMYK build on the real stock.
Install the web-icon set (variants/) into the site, app and social profiles.
Run a trademark search on the name and the mark before launch.

concepts.name: The Woven Frame
concepts.idea: A single unbroken thread weaves a frame around an 'A' — so one shape carries both the monogram and the human hand, and 'intelligence' and 'approachable' share the same line.
rationale: The negative-space 'A' appears only after a second look — the mark rewards attention.
One continuous line: no closed shapes, so it survives at 16 px and in one colour.
Green instead of the category's blue — distinct, and it reads calm rather than loud.
Everything is on a 16-unit grid with one corner radius, so it scales cleanly.
